# CyberArk Identity

## Single sign-on (SAML 2.0)

In the portal, choose **CyberArk Identity** under Enterprise SSO and **Start with CyberArk Identity**. Then, in CyberArk Identity:

1. In the Identity Administration portal, click Apps, then Add Web Apps, and on the Custom tab click Add next to SAML.
2. Enter a Name and Description on the Settings page.
3. On the Trust page, under Service Provider Configuration, load our metadata URL — or choose Manual Configuration and enter the SP Entity ID/ Issuer /Audience and Assertion Consumer Service (ACS) URL below.
4. Save, then under Identity Provider Configuration click Copy URL for the metadata (or Download Metadata File).
5. Configure the attributes on the SAML Response page and assign the people who should sign in.

### The values the portal shows

| CyberArk Identity field | Value |
|---|---|
| Metadata (Trust → Service Provider Configuration (URL, then Load)), optional | The portal's SP metadata URL (`https://…/sso/saml/…/metadata`) |
| SP Entity ID/ Issuer /Audience (Trust → Service Provider Configuration → Manual Configuration) | The portal's entity ID (`https://…/sso/saml/…`) |
| Assertion Consumer Service (ACS) URL (Trust → Service Provider Configuration → Manual Configuration) | The portal's ACS URL (`https://…/sso/saml/…/acs`) |

### What to bring back

Copy **Copy URL** — the URL, or the XML — and paste it into the portal's **Metadata URL or XML**. Prefer the URL.

The assertion must be signed, and must carry the person's email address as an attribute or as a NameID in the `emailAddress` format. See [Any SAML 2.0 provider](generic-saml.md) for the details.

CyberArk Identity's own guide: <https://docs.cyberark.com/manage/latest/en/content/identity/applications/appscustom/addconfigsaml.htm>.

Then verify your domain and turn single sign-on on in the portal: [Enterprise SSO](../sso.md).

## Directory Sync (SCIM)

In the portal, choose **CyberArk Identity** under Directory sync and **Create directory**; copy the bearer token now, it is shown once. Then, in CyberArk Identity:

1. Open the custom SAML app's Provisioning tab and select "Enable provisioning for this application", in Live Mode.
2. Enter the SCIM Service URL below.
3. Set Authorization Type to Authorization Header and Header Type to Bearer Token, and paste the token below into Bearer Token.
4. Click Verify, then choose the roles to provision.

### The values the portal shows

| CyberArk Identity field | Value |
|---|---|
| SCIM Service URL (Provisioning) | The portal's SCIM base URL (`https://…/scim/v2`) |
| Authorization Type (Provisioning) | `Authorization Header` |
| Header Type (Provisioning) | `Bearer Token` |
| Bearer Token (Provisioning) | The bearer token the portal shows once |

CyberArk Identity's own guide: <https://docs.cyberark.com/manage/latest/en/content/identity/applications/appscustom/configsaml_adminautoprov.htm>.
